---
title: "Size portfolios"
jupyter: python3
---

This pilot forms monthly size quintiles and measures their next-month returns.
It uses CRSP CIZ, a short historical subset (2000–2002 holding months), and breakpoints
computed from all eligible observations rather than NYSE-only breakpoints.
Its purpose is to compare the Polars sort with AnomalyLab on identical inputs,
not to match the textbook's tables.

## Read the stock-month panel

Use ordinary U.S.-incorporated common shares of corporations on the NYSE,
AMEX, and Nasdaq at **formation**. Use positive market capitalization for
both the sort and the portfolio weights. Don't require a stock to meet the same
screen in the holding month: keep its reported CIZ return if present, including
a return for a delisting month when available.

```{python}
import polars as pl
from era_pl import load_parquet

first = pl.date(2000, 1, 1)
last = pl.date(2002, 12, 1)
monthly = (
    load_parquet("msf_v2", "crsp")
    .with_columns(month=pl.col("mthcaldt").dt.month_start())
    .filter(pl.col("month").is_between(first.dt.offset_by("-1mo"), last))
)
stock_months = monthly.select("permno", "month")
assert stock_months.collect().is_duplicated().sum() == 0, "Duplicate stock-months"

formation = (
    monthly.filter(
        pl.col("securitytype") == "EQTY",
        pl.col("securitysubtype") == "COM",
        pl.col("sharetype") == "NS",
        pl.col("usincflg") == "Y",
        pl.col("issuertype").is_in(["ACOR", "CORP"]),
        pl.col("primaryexch").is_in(["A", "N", "Q"]),
        pl.col("tradingstatusflg") == "A",
        pl.col("conditionaltype") == "RW",
        pl.col("mthcap") > 0,
    )
    .select(
        "permno",
        pl.col("month").dt.offset_by("1mo").alias("month"),
        pl.col("mthcap").alias("size"),
    )
    .filter(pl.col("month").is_between(first, last))
)
returns = monthly.select("permno", "month", pl.col("mthret").alias("ret"))
panel = formation.join(returns, on=["permno", "month"], how="left").collect()
complete = panel.filter(pl.col("ret").is_finite())
print(f"{panel.height:,} formation observations; {complete.height:,} with a usable return.")
```

The join advances the calendar by exactly one month. It does not jump a gap
to the next available observed return. For this parity check, we follow
AnomalyLab by dropping missing holding-period returns **before** computing
breakpoints. That can change the portfolios using information that wasn't
known at formation. A backtest should instead freeze the breakpoints and
assignments at formation, then handle missing returns separately.

## Sort within each month

Use linear quantiles and right-closed bins, like the reference's
`pandas.qcut` quintiles. Values equal to a breakpoint stay in the lower bin.
Stop rather than silently breaking ties if quantile edges coincide.

```{python}
probs = [0, .2, .4, .6, .8, 1]
edges = [f"q{i}" for i in range(len(probs))]
cutoffs = complete.group_by("month").agg(
    pl.col("size").quantile(q, interpolation="linear").alias(edge)
    for q, edge in zip(probs, edges)
)
assert cutoffs.height > 0, "No complete stock-months"
assert not cutoffs.select(
    pl.any_horizontal(pl.col(a) >= pl.col(b) for a, b in zip(edges, edges[1:])).any()
).item(), "Non-unique quantile edges"

members = (
    complete.join(cutoffs, on="month")
    .with_columns(
        quintile=1 + pl.sum_horizontal(
            (pl.col("size") > pl.col(edge)).cast(pl.Int32) for edge in edges[1:-1]
        )
    )
    .select("permno", "month", "size", "ret", "quintile")
)
```

## Compare returns

Compute one equal-weighted and one value-weighted return per month and quintile.
Then take the arithmetic mean over months. The spread is large minus small.
Returns in the table are percentages per month; the calculations use decimals.

```{python}
monthly_returns = members.group_by("month", "quintile").agg(
    equal_weighted=pl.col("ret").mean(),
    value_weighted=(pl.col("ret") * pl.col("size")).sum() / pl.col("size").sum(),
).sort("month", "quintile")
assert monthly_returns.group_by("month").len()["len"].eq(5).all()

small = monthly_returns.filter(pl.col("quintile") == 1)
large = monthly_returns.filter(pl.col("quintile") == 5)
spread = large.join(small, on="month", suffix="_small").select(
    "month",
    pl.lit(6, dtype=pl.Int32).alias("quintile"),
    (pl.col("equal_weighted") - pl.col("equal_weighted_small")).alias("equal_weighted"),
    (pl.col("value_weighted") - pl.col("value_weighted_small")).alias("value_weighted"),
)
all_returns = pl.concat([monthly_returns, spread])
summary = all_returns.group_by("quintile").agg(
    pl.len().alias("months"),
    (100 * pl.col("equal_weighted").mean()).round(3).alias("equal_weighted_pct"),
    (100 * pl.col("value_weighted").mean()).round(3).alias("value_weighted_pct"),
).sort("quintile").with_columns(
    portfolio=pl.when(pl.col("quintile") == 6).then(pl.lit("Large − small"))
    .otherwise(pl.col("quintile").cast(pl.String))
).drop("quintile").select("portfolio", "months", "equal_weighted_pct", "value_weighted_pct")
summary
```

No factor adjustment or inference is applied in this chapter.

```{python}
#| include: false

# Optional parity check, against an unmodified upstream checkout.
import os

if checkout := os.environ.get("ANOMALYLAB_CHECKOUT"):
    import sys
    from pathlib import Path

    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd

    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(checkout).expanduser().resolve(strict=True)))
    from anomalylab import Panel

    reference = Panel(complete.sort("month", "permno").to_pandas(),
                      id="permno", time="month", frequency="M", ret="ret")
    reference_members = reference.group("ret", "size", "size", 5)
    expected_keys = (
        reference_members[["month", "permno", "size_g5"]]
        .rename(columns={"size_g5": "quintile"})
        .sort_values(["month", "permno"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    )
    actual_keys = members.sort("month", "permno").select(
        "month", "permno", "quintile"
    ).to_pandas()
    actual_keys["month"] = actual_keys["month"].dt.to_period("M")
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual_keys, expected_keys, check_dtype=False)

    ew, vw = reference.univariate_analysis("ret", "size", "size", 5, factor_return=True)
    actual = all_returns.to_pandas()
    actual["month"] = actual["month"].dt.to_period("M")
    actual["quintile"] = actual["quintile"].replace({6: "H-L"})
    actual = actual.set_index(["month", "quintile"])
    errors = {}
    for col, expected in [("equal_weighted", ew), ("value_weighted", vw)]:
        assert len(actual) == len(expected) and set(actual.index) == set(expected.index)
        obs = actual[col].reindex(expected.index).to_numpy()
        np.testing.assert_allclose(obs, expected.to_numpy(), atol=1e-12, rtol=0)
        errors[col] = float(np.max(np.abs(obs - expected.to_numpy())))
    print(f"Matched {members.height:,} assignments and {len(actual)} portfolio-months;"
          f" maximum absolute differences: {errors}", file=sys.stderr)
```
